title: Nvidia staffs new AI safety team amid its push for open models
excerpt: Nvidia is staffing a new AI safety team, signaling a bigger investment in secure AI as it doubles down on open-weight models.
content_html:
Nvidia is assembling a new AI safety and security engineering team, according to a cluster of job listings posted late last month.

The company is hiring a distinguished engineer to serve as a "founding technical leader" for the "newly assembled team," as well as a security research engineer, an evaluation engineer, and a senior manager. The team will evaluate AI agents before they're deployed and build AI-powered tools to patch software vulnerabilities, according to the job listings.

The hiring suggests Nvidia is making AI safety a bigger priority as it bets on a future shaped by open-weight models and AI agents. Open-weight models make their trained "weights" — which determine how they behave — publicly available, even if their training data and source code stay private.

The team is described in one listing as "rooted in the firm belief that open-weight models, transparency, and broad scientific scrutiny are foundational to American AI leadership and cybersecurity defense."

Nvidia did not respond to a request for comment from Business Insider.

In recent months, Nvidia has steadily elevated its public messaging around open-weight AI models, which stand in contrast to the closed systems built by companies like OpenAI and Anthropic.

In his first post on X last month, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang shared a letter urging US policymakers to support open models, saying that they "strengthen safety and cybersecurity."

Days later, Nvidia announced it had become a founding member of the Open Secure AI Alliance — a group building open-source security tools for AI. The job listings for the chipmaker's AI safety team appeared prior to this announcement and describe many of the same responsibilities.

The alliance includes 120 companies, such as Microsoft, Palantir, SpaceX, and Hugging Face, which recently relied on an open model to respond to a high-profile security incident.

While critics say open models are more accessible to bad actors, proponents say they bolster innovation through competition and improve security through transparency and collective action.

AI safety sells

The push toward open models and AI security isn't just philosophical; it reflects key business incentives for Nvidia.

Open models put AI into the hands of far more customers, in turn creating more demand for Nvidia's AI chips needed to power it.

Safety is also critical as Nvidia pushes for broader business adoption of AI, and companies weigh how best to deploy it.

As AI shifts from chatbots to agents that can access sensitive company data and take real-world actions, trust could become the linchpin for widespread adoption.

content_html_zh:
根据上个月末发布的一系列招聘信息，英伟达正在组建一个新的人工智能安全和安保工程团队。

该公司正在聘请一名杰出工程师作为“新组建的团队”的“创始技术负责人”，以及一名安全研究工程师、一名评估工程师和一名高级经理。 根据职位列表，该团队将在部署人工智能代理之前对其进行评估，并构建人工智能驱动的工具来修补软件漏洞。

这次招聘表明，英伟达正在将人工智能安全放在更重要的位置，因为它押注于开放权重模型和人工智能代理塑造的未来。 开放权重模型使其训练有素的“权重”（决定其行为方式）公开可用，即使其训练数据和源代码保持私密。

在一份名单中，该团队被描述为“坚信开放权重模型、透明度和广泛的科学审查是美国人工智能领导地位和网络安全防御的基础”。

英伟达没有回应《商业内幕》的置评请求。

近几个月来，Nvidia 稳步提升了围绕开放式人工智能模型的公共信息，这与 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 等公司构建的封闭系统形成鲜明对比。

上个月，英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋在 X 上发表的第一篇文章中分享了一封信，敦促美国政策制定者支持开放模式，称它们“加强了安全和网络安全”。

几天后，英伟达宣布它已成为开放安全人工智能联盟的创始成员，该联盟是一个为人工智能构建开源安全工具的组织。 该芯片制造商的人工智能安全团队的职位清单早于本公告发布，并描述了许多相同的职责。

该联盟包括微软、Palantir、SpaceX、Hugging Face 等 120 家公司，最近依靠开放模式应对了备受瞩目的安全事件。

虽然批评者称开放模式更容易被不良行为者利用，但支持者表示，开放模式通过竞争促进创新，并通过透明度和集体行动提高安全性。

人工智能安全畅销

对开放模型和人工智能安全的推动不仅仅是哲学上的，也是哲学上的。它反映了英伟达的关键业务激励措施。

开放模型让更多客户能够掌握人工智能，进而为驱动人工智能的英伟达人工智能芯片创造更多需求。

随着英伟达推动人工智能在商业领域的更广泛应用，安全也至关重要，而各公司也在权衡如何最好地部署人工智能。

随着人工智能从聊天机器人转变为可以访问敏感公司数据并采取实际行动的代理，信任可能成为广泛采用的关键。
